name: Fanshawe College
description: Fanshawe College is located in London, Ontario, Canada, just 2 hours from Toronto, Niagara Falls and Detroit, USA. Known as the "Forest City" for its scenic parks and lakes, London is also a business and cultural center. 6,500 foreign students from 100 different countries study at Fanshawe College, and the total number of full-time students is 21,000.
